text: Dealing with somebody else’s emotional insecurities can also be exhausting. It’s easy to feel free when I don’t have to do that, especially since I’m a bit of an introvert and 10% autistic. All that works wonderfully until I’m in a romantic relationship and suddenly I’m expected to mind-read, silences included, and check in constantly, without manipulating based on all that expert “management.”
reader: Someone used to living alone, about to share daily life with a partner.
